presets.label: Scan
presets.note: Fast triage of a niche. Structural pod signals only — peer-cohort stats withhold below n=15, and the cross-creator reuse graph is thin at 10 creators.

presets.label: Standard
presets.note: Working shortlist. Solid pod/burst/templated detection; per-tier cohort cells usually still sit below n=15, so outlier stats may withhold — honestly labeled when they do.

presets.label: Deep
presets.note: Shortlist-grade. The dominant vertical×tier cell approaches n≥15 so peer-band statistics can fire, and the reuse graph is at its strongest. The depth used for client-facing runs.
